findings.decision: Dedicated --git-executable ABSOLUTE_PATH; run_git_notes parses before invoking statically typed app constructor closure; sealed positive SDK/CLI proof injects real standard Git, PATH remains empty; missing Git tested separately.

Named run_git_notes frontend/parser, SourceRepresentation::GitNotes registry row, repository fixture branch and precise static descriptor/capabilities with empty locations. Existing frontends/invocations unchanged. Reject rationale that additive syntax is inherently prohibited.

Every record including manifest has the four required common keys and Git format/structural revision keys. Exact object-native provenance, field meanings and selection-scoped manifest semantics are specified. No source offsets/timestamps/spans.

Syntactically valid unresolved attribution keys emit source evidence with identity_resolution=unresolved, no synthesis or cross-note lookup. Selected non-commit targets are explicit UnsupportedTarget failures; missing objects ObjectRead; no silent dropping.
Retain documented 7-character compatibility keys independently, verbatim. Specification section1.2.3.1 line193 explicitly SHOULD-accepts them; no private cache/implementation needed.
Explicit normal unquoted/optionally quoted paths, positive single-line numbers, inclusive ranges and comma-separated combinations.

Exact narrow boot extension/check-regression and operating-doc ownership added. Real git-notes proof joins boot with honest scope; failure propagation, not repinned wording, is the readiness contract.

Explicit Commits/read_note use pinned nonrecursive literal-pathspec fanout lookup, not whole tree. All remains bounded. Unix only, typed UnsafeRepository refusal with actionable guidance and no global safe.directory override.
Concrete GitObjectLoader is distinct from the core GitNoteLoader trait.

Canonical selected worktree top-level, per-worktree Git directory and common Git directory are excluded from new outputs, including nested repo input/symlink parent aliases. Caller-owned output-parent race assumption is explicit.
16 MiB input is not claimed to fit 32 MiB output; existing writer independently rejects encoded overflow before touching destination.
